title: orders-service
blurb: Concurrent checkouts are overselling inventory. Find the race, preserve the order and stock contracts, and keep unrelated SKUs moving in parallel.
brief:
This order service handles checkouts for a flash-sale platform. Under load, inventory counts go negative — customers are buying stock that doesn't exist.

The test suite covers the working order, discount, stock, and checkout contracts as well as the failing concurrent path.

**Your job:** make all tests green without breaking the passing behavior. The fix should still allow concurrent checkouts of *different* SKUs to proceed in parallel.

javascript.brief:
This Node.js order service handles concurrent checkouts for a flash-sale platform. Under load, many buyers reserve the same limited inventory because the availability check and decrement are separated by an asynchronous authorization step.

Run the tests. The concurrency contract expects exactly the available number of checkouts to succeed, inventory to stop at zero, and unrelated SKUs to remain independent.

**Your job:** make all tests green without breaking the passing behavior. Do not solve the race by serializing reservations for different SKUs.
